Hi Amy & team —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our end and proposal for next steps:

- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for clinical note generation and centralize embedding storage for search.
- Key constraints: SOC2 controls, VPC-only deployment for PHI, predictable 99th pct latency targets.

Suggested next step
- Technical walkthrough (45–60 min) with your infra and engineering leads so Karthik can map architecture and we can discuss deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).

Proposed windows (PST) — pick one or share alternatives:
- Tue Apr 19 — 09:00–10:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed Apr 20 — 11:00–12:00 or 16:00–17:00

Proposed attendees from our side:
- Rishi Malhotra — Account Exec (me)
- Karthik Iyer — Solutions Architect
- Neha Kapoor — Customer Success (onboard + SLA discussion)

Can you confirm preferred slot and whether you want Zoom or Google Meet? Also share the list of internal attendees on your side so we can tailor the agenda.

I attached a short draft agenda. I can send a calendar invite as soon as you confirm.

Thanks,
